newsitem.title: GERMANY: Three killed as plane hits truck on German road.
newsitem.headline: Three killed as plane hits truck on German road.

text.p: A small aircraft crashed onto a busy road in Germany on Monday, colliding with a truck and killing three people.
The single-engine plane tried to return to Paulushofen airport, southern Germany, soon after take-off but missed the runway in thick fog, police said.
All three occupants of the plane -- two men and a woman -- were killed and the truck driver was taken to hospital suffering from shock and other injuries.
